docs.title: GoReady
docs.text: Prepare today. Stay ready tomorrow. GoReady is an offline-first emergency preparedness companion that helps individuals and families organize emergency bags, track supplies, and review important preparedness information.

docs.title: Key Features
docs.text:
• Manage multiple emergency bags
  • Track supply quantities
  • Monitor expiration dates
  • Store emergency information
  • Works offline
  • Local notification reminders

docs.title: New to GoReady?
docs.text:
• User Guide

  • Privacy Policy

  • Disclaimer

GoReady is a personal preparedness tool and does not provide emergency response, medical advice, or disaster prediction services.

Please review the Disclaimer before relying on any preparedness recommendations.

docs.title: Disclaimer
docs.text:
GoReady provides general preparedness information and organizational tools for reference purposes only.

Preparedness recommendations, emergency guidance, and checklist content may not be suitable for every situation, region, household, or medical condition.

Users should evaluate their own needs and follow guidance from local authorities, emergency services, healthcare professionals, or other qualified organizations when appropriate.

GoReady is not a medical, rescue, or emergency response service.

docs.title: GoReady Privacy Policy
docs.text: Last updated: October 28, 2026

docs.title: 1. Introduction
docs.text:
GoReady (“the App”) is designed to help users manage disaster preparedness information, emergency supply inventories, and related emergency response reference materials.

We respect your privacy and design the App according to the principle of data minimization. This Privacy Policy explains how the App stores, uses, and transmits information.

docs.title: 2. User-Created and Stored Data
docs.text:
The App may store the following information in its app-specific storage on the user’s device:

  • Emergency bag information
  • Item names, quantities, notes, brands, purchase dates, places of purchase, prices, expiration dates, and warranty dates
  • User-created tags and category names
  • Emergency contact names, relationships, telephone numbers, and notes
  • Emergency contact card information, including:
  • Name
  • Telephone number
  • Emergency meeting locations
  • Images selected by the user and associated with emergency bags, items, or emergency contact cards

This information is primarily stored in the App’s local, app-specific storage.

GoReady currently does not provide a developer-operated account system or cloud synchronization service for emergency preparedness data. The App does not upload the database or associated images described above to servers operated by the GoReady developer.

docs.title: 3. Operating System Backups and Device Transfer
docs.text:
Depending on the user’s device, operating system version, and backup settings, the App’s local data may be backed up or restored through Apple iCloud Backup, Android Auto Backup, or operating-system device transfer features.

These backups are processed by Apple, Google, or the device manufacturer under their respective terms and privacy policies. They are not cloud synchronization services provided by GoReady.

Users can manage available backup options through their device settings.

docs.title: 4. Permissions and Device Features
docs.text: The App may request the following permissions when required by a feature.

docs.title: Photo Access
docs.text:
When the user selects an image for an emergency bag, item, or emergency contact card, the App may request access to the selected photo.

The selected image is copied into the App’s app-specific storage.

docs.title: Notifications
docs.text:
The App may request notification permission to provide disaster preparedness reminders, such as item expiration reminders.

These reminders are handled through the device’s notification system.

docs.title: Location
docs.text:
When the user chooses to include their current location in a safety check-in message, the App requests foreground location permission and obtains the device’s current latitude and longitude.

The location is used to prepare the message requested by the user. The App does not continuously track the user’s location and does not send this location to servers operated by the GoReady developer.

Users may decline these permissions or change them at any time through their device settings.

docs.title: 5. Information Shared at the User’s Direction
docs.text:
When the user uses the calling or safety check-in messaging feature, the App may provide a telephone number, name, and—if specifically selected by the user—the user’s current location to the device’s phone or messaging application.

The user reviews and confirms the message through the system messaging interface before sending it. After the message is sent, the information may be processed by the user’s telecommunications provider, messaging service, and the recipient.

When the user opens a bug report or feedback form, the App directs the user to a form provided through Google Forms. To assist with troubleshooting, the form link may be prefilled with the following technical information:

  • Device platform
  • Operating system version
  • App version and build number
  • Device time zone, for bug reports only

Information that the user enters and submits through the form is processed by Google and the GoReady maintenance team for the stated purpose of the form.

Users should not include emergency contact card information, telephone numbers, precise location data, or other unnecessary sensitive information in these forms.

GoReady does not sell user data.

docs.title: 6. Error Monitoring and Diagnostic Data
docs.text:
To maintain the stability of the App, we use Sentry for error and crash monitoring in production and preview versions.

Diagnostic data that may be transmitted includes:

  • Error types, error codes, and technical stack traces
  • App version, runtime environment, and update identifiers
  • Technical information such as operating system, device platform, language, and time zone
  • A randomly generated installation identifier
  • Database schema version
  • Types of features or actions involved when an error occurs

We have disabled Sentry's default transmission of personally identifiable information and implemented data filtering mechanisms to reduce the risk of unintentionally transmitting names, phone numbers, meeting locations, notes, or other sensitive information.

Diagnostic data is processed by Sentry in accordance with its privacy and security policies and is used solely for error analysis, system security, and service improvement.

docs.title: 7. Data Retention and Deletion
docs.text:
Users can edit or delete data they have created within the App.

When data is deleted, the App removes the corresponding local data. However, copies previously created by an operating-system backup may continue to exist under the backup retention practices of Apple, Google, or the device manufacturer. Such data may reappear if an earlier device backup is restored.

Uninstalling the App will generally remove data from the App’s app-specific storage on the current device. It may not automatically delete:

  • Existing cloud or device backups
  • Messages that have already been sent
  • Bug reports or feedback that has already been submitted

Diagnostic information and form submissions are retained only for the period required by the relevant service provider and the GoReady maintenance team for the purposes described in this policy.

docs.title: 8. Third-Party and System Services
docs.text:
The App may use or interact with the following third-party or operating-system services:

  • System backup and device transfer services provided by Apple or Google
  • Sentry error-monitoring services
  • Google Forms for bug reports and feedback
  • Device phone, messaging, notification, photo-selection, and location services

These services may process information under their own privacy policies.

docs.title: 9. Children’s Privacy
docs.text:
GoReady is not specifically designed for children who are below the age at which they may independently consent under applicable law.

If a parent or legal guardian allows a child to use the App, they should assist the child in avoiding the entry or external transmission of unnecessary sensitive personal information.

docs.title: 10. Changes to This Privacy Policy
docs.text:
We may update this Privacy Policy to reflect changes to the App’s features, legal requirements, or third-party services.

When this policy is updated, we will revise the “Last updated” date shown above.

If a change materially affects how information is collected, used, or shared, we may provide an additional notice within the App or through an appropriate publication channel.

docs.title: 11. Contact Us
docs.text:
If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or the App’s data-handling practices, please contact us at:

GoReady Support Email: rowan.li.tw@gmail.com

docs.title: What Is GoReady?
docs.text: GoReady helps you organize disaster preparedness information, manage emergency bags and supplies, receive expiration reminders, and keep important emergency reference information available on your device.

docs.title: Getting Started
docs.text:
1. Create an emergency bag.
  2. Add preparedness items.
  3. Set expiration and warranty dates where applicable.
  4. Create an emergency contact card if needed.
  5. Review and update your supplies regularly.

docs.title: Does GoReady require an internet connection?
docs.text:
Most core features work offline, including managing emergency bags, supplies, and emergency contact cards.

Some features may require an internet connection or telecommunications service, including opening online support forms, sending text messages, and operating-system cloud backup services.

docs.title: Is my data uploaded to a server?
docs.text:
GoReady does not upload your emergency preparedness database or associated images to servers operated by the GoReady developer.

Depending on your device settings, your data may be backed up or restored through iCloud Backup, Android Auto Backup, or operating-system device transfer features.

The App may also send limited and filtered error diagnostic information to Sentry.

When you choose to send a safety check-in message or submit a support form, the information you choose to provide will be processed by the applicable messaging, telecommunications, or form service. Please refer to the Privacy Policy for details.

docs.title: Support
docs.text:
Thank you for using GoReady.

If you need help, want to report a problem, or would like to share feedback, please use one of the forms below.

  • Report a Problem

Use this form if you experienced a bug, crash, incorrect behavior, or notification issue.

Report a Problem

Please do not include sensitive personal in the report.

  • Suggestions and Feedback

Use this form if you have ideas for improving GoReady.

Send Feedback

  • Privacy Reminder

GoReady may store emergency contact card information locally on your device, such as the card holder’s name and phone number, emergency meeting points, emergency contacts’ names, relationships and phone numbers, and notes.

Please do not include sensitive information from your emergency contact card in support requests or feedback forms.

For more information, please read our Privacy Policy.

docs.title: 免責聲明
docs.text:
GoReady 提供的一般防災資訊與管理工具僅供參考使用。

防災建議、緊急應變指引與檢查清單內容，可能不適用於所有情況、地區、家庭環境或醫療狀況。

使用者應依自身需求進行評估，並在適當情況下遵循當地政府機關、緊急救援單位、醫療專業人員或其他專業機構之指引。

GoReady 並非醫療、救援或緊急應變服務。

docs.title: GoReady 隱私權政策
docs.text: 最後更新日期：2026 年 10 月 28 日

docs.title: 1. 簡介
docs.text:
GoReady（以下稱「本 App」）旨在協助使用者管理防災準備資訊、防災物資清單，以及相關的緊急應變參考資料。

我們重視您的隱私，並以資料最小化為原則設計本 App。本政策說明本 App 儲存、使用及傳送資料的方式。

docs.title: 2. 使用者建立及儲存的資料
docs.text:
本 App 可能在使用者裝置的 App 專屬儲存空間內保存以下資料：

  • 防災背包資訊
  • 物品名稱、數量、備註、品牌、購買日期、購買來源、價格、有效期限及保固期限
  • 使用者建立的標籤及分類名稱
  • 緊急聯絡人姓名、關係、電話號碼及備註
  • 緊急聯絡卡資訊，包括：
  • 姓名
  • 電話號碼
  • 緊急集合地點
  • 使用者選擇並與防災背包、物品或緊急聯絡卡關聯的圖片

這些資料主要儲存在 App 的本機專屬儲存空間。GoReady 目前未提供由開發者營運的帳號系統或防災資料雲端同步服務，也不會將上述資料庫或圖片上傳至開發者的伺服器。

docs.title: 3. 作業系統備份及裝置移轉
docs.text:
依照使用者的裝置、作業系統版本及備份設定，本 App 的本機資料可能由 Apple iCloud Backup、Android Auto Backup，或作業系統提供的裝置移轉功能進行備份及還原。

這類備份由 Apple、Google 或裝置製造商依其服務條款及隱私政策處理，並非 GoReady 提供的雲端同步功能。

使用者可透過裝置的系統設定管理可用的備份選項。

docs.title: 4. 權限及裝置功能
docs.text: 本 App 可能依功能需要請求以下權限：

docs.title: 照片權限
docs.text: 當使用者選擇防災背包、物品或緊急聯絡卡圖片時，本 App 會請求存取使用者選取的照片。選取的圖片會複製至 App 的專屬儲存空間。

docs.title: 通知權限
docs.text: 本 App 可能請求通知權限，用於提供物品到期等防災準備提醒。提醒由裝置上的通知功能處理。

docs.title: 位置權限
docs.text:
當使用者選擇在安全回報簡訊中加入目前位置時，本 App 會請求前景位置權限並取得當下的經緯度。

位置資訊用於產生使用者要求的簡訊內容。本 App 不會持續追蹤位置，也不會將位置傳送至 GoReady 開發者的伺服器。

使用者可拒絕權限，或隨時透過裝置設定變更權限。

docs.title: 5. 使用者主動分享的資料
docs.text:
當使用者使用撥號或安全回報簡訊功能時，本 App 可能將電話號碼、姓名，以及使用者選擇加入的目前位置，交由裝置的電話或簡訊 App 處理。

簡訊在送出前由使用者透過系統簡訊介面確認。簡訊送出後，相關資料將由使用者的電信服務商、簡訊服務及收件人處理。

當使用者開啟問題回報或意見回饋表單時，將進入由 Google 提供的表單服務。為協助問題排查，表單連結可能預先帶入以下技術資訊：

  • 裝置平台
  • 作業系統版本
  • App 版本及建置版本
  • 裝置時區（僅問題回報）

使用者主動填入表單的內容將由 Google 及 GoReady 維護團隊依表單用途處理。請勿在表單中填寫緊急聯絡卡、電話號碼、精確位置或其他不必要的敏感資料。

GoReady 不會販售使用者資料。

docs.title: 6. 錯誤監控及診斷資料
docs.text:
為維持 App 的穩定性，本 App 在正式或預覽版本中使用 Sentry 提供錯誤及當機監控。

可能傳送的診斷資料包括：

  • 錯誤類型、錯誤代碼及技術堆疊
  • App 版本、執行環境及更新版本識別資訊
  • 作業系統、裝置平台、語言及時區等技術資訊
  • 隨機產生的安裝識別碼
  • 資料庫結構版本
  • 發生錯誤時的功能或操作類型

本 App 已停用 Sentry 的預設個人識別資料傳送，並設有資料過濾機制，以降低姓名、電話號碼、集合地點、備註及其他敏感內容被意外傳送的風險。

診斷資料由 Sentry 依其隱私及安全條款處理，僅用於錯誤分析、系統安全及服務改善。

docs.title: 7. 資料保存與刪除
docs.text:
使用者可在 App 內編輯或刪除其建立的資料。

刪除資料時，本 App 會移除相應的本機資料；但先前由作業系統建立的備份可能依 Apple、Google或裝置製造商的備份保留規則繼續存在，並可能在還原裝置時重新出現。

移除本 App 通常會刪除目前裝置內 App 專屬儲存空間中的資料，但不一定會自動刪除既有的系統雲端備份、已送出的簡訊，或已提交的問題回報及意見回饋。

錯誤監控與表單資料的保存期間，依相關服務提供者及 GoReady 維護所需期間處理。

docs.title: 8. 第三方服務
docs.text:
本 App 可能使用以下第三方或系統服務：

  • Apple 或 Google 提供的系統備份及裝置移轉服務
  • Sentry 錯誤監控服務
  • Google Forms 問題回報及意見回饋服務
  • 裝置的電話、簡訊、通知、照片選取及定位服務

第三方服務可能依其各自的隱私政策處理資料。

docs.title: 9. 兒童隱私
docs.text:
GoReady 並非專門針對未達適用法律規定可獨立同意年齡之兒童所設計。

若家長或監護人允許兒童使用本 App，應協助其避免輸入或對外傳送不必要的敏感個人資料。

docs.title: 10. 隱私權政策變更
docs.text:
本隱私權政策可能因功能、法規或第三方服務調整而更新。更新時，我們將修改本政策上方的「最後更新日期」。

若變更會重大影響資料的蒐集、使用或分享方式，我們將視情況在 App 或相關發布管道中提供通知。

docs.title: 11. 聯絡方式
docs.text:
若您對本隱私權政策或資料處理方式有任何疑問，請透過以下方式聯絡：

GoReady Support Email: rowan.li.tw@gmail.com

docs.title: GoReady 是什麼
docs.text: GoReady 協助您整理防災準備資訊、管理防災背包與物資、接收物品到期提醒，並將重要的緊急應變資訊保存在您的裝置上，以便需要時查閱。

docs.title: 開始使用
docs.text:
1. 建立防災背包。
  2. 加入防災物資。
  3. 視需要設定有效期限與保固期限。
  4. 如有需要，建立緊急聯絡卡。
  5. 定期檢查並更新您的防災物資。

docs.title: GoReady 是否需要網路連線？
docs.text:
大部分核心功能可離線使用，包括管理防災背包、物品與緊急聯絡卡。

部分功能可能需要網路或電信服務，例如開啟線上支援表單、傳送簡訊，以及作業系統提供的雲端備份。

docs.title: 我的資料會上傳到伺服器嗎？
docs.text:
GoReady 不會將您的防災資料庫或圖片上傳到開發者營運的伺服器。

依照您的裝置設定，資料可能由 iCloud Backup、Android Auto Backup 或裝置移轉功能備份及還原。App 也可能將經過限制及過濾的錯誤診斷資料傳送至 Sentry。

當您主動傳送安全回報簡訊或提交支援表單時，您選擇提供的內容將交由相應的簡訊、電信或表單服務處理。詳情請參閱隱私權政策。

docs.title: 支援
docs.text:
感謝您使用 GoReady。

如果您需要協助、回報問題，或希望提供建議與回饋，請使用下方對應的表單。

  • 問題回報

若您遇到 bug、App 閃退、異常行為或通知相關問題，請使用表單：

問題回報

請勿在回報內容中填寫敏感個人資料。

  • 建議與回饋

如果您對 GoReady 有功能改善建議或其他回饋，歡迎使用此表單。

提供回饋

  • 隱私提醒

GoReady 可能會在您的裝置上儲存緊急聯絡卡資料，例如持有者的姓名與電話號碼、災時集合地點、緊急聯絡人的姓名、關係與電話號碼，以及備註。

請勿在支援請求或意見回饋表單中提供緊急聯絡卡中的敏感資料。

如需更多資訊，請閱讀我們的 隱私權政策。

  • 聯絡方式

GoReady Support Email: rowan.li.tw@gmail.com
